paragraphs: A Salmonella outbreak linked to raw oysters remains ongoing, with 27 cases reported across 12 states and 5 hospitalizations as of October 19 [1]. Virginia is reporting more patients than the CDC has counted in this outbreak [8], and the state has temporarily closed Little Wicomico River to shellfish harvesting [19].

Kayem Foods Inc. is recalling various ready-to-eat meat and poultry products due to possible temperature abuse [2]. The recall is a Class I, meaning there is a reasonable probability that the products could cause serious adverse health consequences [2]. Consumers should check their freezers for products bearing "EST. M/P 7839," "EST. P 20935A," or "EST. M 9520" inside the USDA mark of inspection [2].

Two additional recalls pose health risks: Lidl US is recalling Gelatelli Coffee & Vanilla Gelato (Lot 085261, Best By MAR/26/2028) due to possible Listeria monocytogenes contamination [6], and Family Farmstead Dairy is recalling raw mild cheddar cheese that may be contaminated with E. coli O157:H7 [7]. Krasnyi Oktyabr Inc. is also recalling STARFISH SEAFOOD PREMIUM COLD SMOKED NORWEGIAN SALMON SLICED after it tested positive for Listeria monocytogenes [20].
